import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Fraud Distribution by Transaction Type
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], width=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Fraud vs Non-Fraud by Transaction Type', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 0].legend(['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'], loc='upper right')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status
fraud_df = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
non_fraud_df = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
axes[0, 1].hist([non_fraud_df, fraud_df], bins=30, label=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'], 
                color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Amount ($)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud Rate by Hour of Day
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day').agg({'is_fraud': ['sum', 'count']})
hourly_fraud.columns = ['fraud_count', 'total_count']
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = (hourly_fraud['fraud_count'] / hourly_fraud['total_count']) * 100
hourly_fraud = hourly_fraud.reset_index()

axes[1, 0].plot(hourly_fraud['hour_of_day'], hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], 
                marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 0].fill_between(hourly_fraud['hour_of_day'], hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], 
                         alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)')
axes[1, 0].grid(alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 4. Box plot: Amount by Transaction Type and Fraud Status
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Non-Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label', 
            ax=axes[1, 1], palette={'Non-Fraud': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'})
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Status')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
